definition: Algoritmos criptográficos para cifras com uma chave criptográfica simétrica.

EA2C.name: AES128CBC
EA2C.definition: Cifra AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) em modo CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) com chave criptográfica de 128 bits, conforme definida pelas Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 - 6 de novembro de 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

E3DC.name: DES112CBC
E3DC.definition: Cifra Triple DES (Data Encryption Standard) em modo CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) com chave de comprimento duplo (112 bits), conforme definida na FIPS PUB 46-3 - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: des-ede3-cbc).

EA9C.name: AES192CBC
EA9C.definition: Cifra AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) em modo CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) com chave criptográfica de 192 bits, conforme definida pelas Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – 6 de novembro de 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EA5C.name: AES256CBC
EA5C.definition: Cifra AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) em modo CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) com chave criptográfica de 256 bits, conforme definida pelas Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – 6 de novembro de 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).
